messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout: runtime v2.3.1 -> starts 2024-09-05 02:00 UTC (rolling across hosted + dedicated). Includes kernel stability fix and variant pin fallback behavior. No expected downtime by default.

lina: pinging support — any specific customer groups we need to notify proactively?

samir: yes — the top 10 dedicated customers + a small set of regulated private deployments. they expect 48h notice.

oncall-ryan: FYI oncall thresholds: if >0.5% 5m error rate for 3 consecutive windows, we hold and roll back.

maya: add a canary note — we'll run canary for 30m on hosted region us-west-2, then expand. mention canary in comms so customers know we’re validating.

support-ops: draft statuspage snippet below — feedback welcome.

support-ops: ```
Scheduled maintenance: rolling runtime update (v2.3.1) — 2024-09-05 02:00 UTC (approx 1h rollout).
Impact: brief increase in request latency for affected hosts for up to ~10 minutes during switchover. No service interruption expected.
Customers on Dedicated: automatic version pinning to v2.2.9 will occur if we detect sustained errors; we will notify affected customers directly.
```

eng-lead: wording: avoid definitive "no downtime" — say "no downtime expected" and call out rollback/pin behavior. also include contact path for high-risk customers.

support-ops: updated snippet: ```
Scheduled maintenance: rolling runtime update (v2.3.1) — 2024-09-05 02:00 UTC (approx 1h rollout).
Impact: no downtime expected; some requests may see transient latency increases (up to ~10m per host).
If we detect sustained errors, affected Dedicated customers will be automatically pinned to v2.2.9; support will notify those customers directly.
If you have concerns, contact support@redwood.ai or open a ticket.
```

lina: ok — customers to notify list attached in DM. support-ops will trigger email + statuspage.

oncall-ryan: escalation plan: if rollback triggered, we push statuspage update to "Degraded performance" and open incident channel. keep me tagged.

support-ops: email subject draft: "Redwood scheduled runtime update — Sep 5 (may affect latency)". body will include: short summary, expected window, canary note, pin fallback, contact links, FAQ link.

maya: can we add a short FAQ Q/A about what pinning means and whether data/config is affected? one line: "Pinning will route your traffic to the last known-good runtime version; it does not change your data or model weights."

support-ops: added FAQ line.

eng-lead: approve. please avoid customer-facing technical jargon in the header. keep details in the body.

support-ops: final checklist: 1) statuspage draft -> ready, 2) email -> ready, 3) DM list -> ready, 4) canary monitor dashboard -> link posted in #eng-releases, 5) oncall watches thresholds.

samir: planning customer outreach at T-minus 48h + reminder at T-minus 1h.

oncall-ryan: noted, I will bring the rollback decision if thresholds hit.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: canary batch 1 at 2024-09-05 02:05 UTC.

support-ops: thanks — will publish the statuspage update now (set to "Scheduled maintenance"). :thumbsup:

lina: great work team — keep the thread updated if canary shows any anomalies.

support-ops: post-deploy followup plan: send summary to notified customers and update the FAQ with results.

oncall-ryan: if we roll back, support-ops to send immediate update with ETA for next attempt.

support-ops: understood. closing prep work here — reopening thread if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
